text: Program Description PROGRAM PERIOD January 6 - 26, 2027 (3 Weeks) 9:00 AM – 11:45 AM (GMT+8) Monday to Friday Registration Dates: January 4 - 5 COURSE CONTENT ※ Chinese Classes: Classes focus on enhancing oral expression, combined with grammar explanation and thematic discussion. Multiple levels are offered, starting from beginner. You will be placed into the appropriate level based on your online placement test result. (Each class requires at least 8 students.) ※ Cultural Lectures / Activities: Cultural activities introduce China's customs and culture in diverse formats, such as the culture of Chinese characters, Chinese cuisine, Chinese calligraphy, Chinese traditional medicine culture, and making Chinese traditional handicrafts, etc. ※ Language Practice: You will complete tasks assigned by teachers in real-world settings—such as visiting shopping malls or parks—where you will communicate directly with local Chinese speakers. This hands-on approach efficiently improves your everyday communication skills. COURSE COMPLETION Students who complete the course and pass the final exam will receive the program completion certificate. ACCOMMODATION Students may choose to live on or off campus. On-campus accommodation depends on availability and will be confirmed by the university. CLASS ARRANGEMENT You will take an online placement test to assess your Chinese proficiency and will be placed in an appropriate class based on the results. During the first week of the program, you may change your class level within a specified timeframe.
